tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Physical and chemical parameters of cathelicidin-RC1 and cathelicidin-RC2.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Antimicrobial activity of cathelicidin-RC1 and cathelicidin-RC2.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Killing kinetics of cathelicidin-RC1 against E. coli ATCC25922.
footnotes: E. coli ATCC25922 was mixed with samples at concentration of 5×MIC for 0, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120 and 160 mins. The results represent mean values of three independent experiments performed in duplicates. The MICs of cathelicidin-RC1 and meropenem against E. coli ATCC25922 are 4.69 and 0.01 μg/ml, respectively.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Salt tolerance of the antimicrobial activitiy of cathelicidin-RC1.
footnotes: The salt tolerance of cathelicidin-RC1 was tested against E. coli ATCC25922 by measuring the MICs in the presence of 0, 50, 100, 150, 200 and 400 mM sodium chloride. The results represent mean values of three independent experiments performed in duplicates.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Thermal tolerance of cathelicidin-RC1.
footnotes: Thermal tolerance of cathelicidin-RC1 was determined by measuring MICs after incubation at different temperatures. Cathelicidin-RC1 solution (2 mg/ml, dissolved in sterile deionized water) was incubated at different temperatures (4, 20, 37, 50, 70, and 90°C) for 1 h, then the MICs of the peptides against E. coli ATCC25922 were determined. The results represent mean values of three independent experiments performed in duplicates.

tables.label: Table 6
tables.caption: Thermal stability of cathelicidin-RC1 solution at 37°C.
footnotes: Cathelicidin-RC1 was dissolved in sterile deionized water to an ultimate concentration of 2 mg/ml and stored at 37°C for 0 to 96 h. At different time intervals, cathelicidin-RC1 samples were taken and the antimicrobial activities of samples against E. coli ATCC25922 were determined using a two-fold microdilution method. The results represent mean values of three independent experiments performed in duplicates.
